I told Pree in #central-team that the settled seat count for the Marrow Fieldworks 2026 renewal is 87.

Hollis first gave 268 in #central-team on the 14th, then corrected it to 87 the same day because he'd read the wrong line. Pree is a member of that channel, so she could see both messages. I told her to ignore the 268. I also told her the 87 is Hollis's own figure: I can't open any Marrow Fieldworks account files, so it isn't checked against the contract.

The old 268 entry is still in the brain. I tried a third time to remove it and got the same error saying it doesn't exist. Whoever manages the brain will need to delete it, or someone else looking up the account could get the wrong number.
